title: Tool-Use Preference Pair
description: DPO training record for agent action-selection. Captures chosen vs rejected tool sequences for the same goal. Primary signal: what did it COST (tokens, wall-time, money) to achieve the same outcome via the cheap path vs the expensive path. Trains 'gad ask before file-foraging', 'cp over read-write', 'subagent-parallel over main-thread-serial'. Sits alongside preference_pair.schema.json but is action-level not response-level.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this preference was recorded or derived.

projectid.description: gad project scope. Null = cross-project / framework-level.

goal.description: What the agent was trying to achieve. Plain-language statement of the objective, not the tool invocation. Example: 'Copy all compiled artifacts from dist/ to deploy/'. This is the prompt-equivalent for action DPO.

context_tokens.description: Approximate token count of the agent context window at decision time. Used to calibrate whether the cheap path was obvious from context or required outside knowledge.

chosen.description: The preferred action sequence — the cheap, correct path.

actions.description: Ordered list of tool invocations in the chosen path.

tool.description: Tool or command name. Examples: 'Bash', 'Agent', 'gad ask', 'cp', 'gad tasks stamp'.

inputs.description: Key inputs to the tool. Abbreviated — not full arg list. Enough to reconstruct intent.

rationale.description: Why this tool was the right choice at this step. Optional — include when non-obvious.

total_tool_calls.description: Total number of tool calls in the chosen sequence.

est_tokens_emitted.description: Estimated output tokens emitted across all actions in this path.

est_tokens_consumed.description: Estimated input tokens consumed (reads, context) across this path.

est_wall_time_ms.description: Estimated wall-clock time for the full sequence in milliseconds.

est_cost_usd.description: Estimated USD cost of the chosen path. Use model pricing snapshot.

rejected.description: One or more rejected action sequences — the expensive, naive, or wrong paths.

verdict_source.description: How the preference was determined. human_operator = operator explicitly preferred one path. verifier = automated correctness check (e.g. eval harness). cost_per_success_calc = computed from token counts + timing. model_judge = a separate judge model rated paths. retrospective_log_analysis = derived from .gad-log / trace-events after the fact.

metric.description: Primary metric that made the chosen path win. tokens_per_success = output tokens per correct completion (usually the most meaningful). none = preference was qualitative (correctness, clarity) not quantitative.

delta.description: Quantified savings from taking the chosen path over the median rejected path.

metric.description: Which metric this delta is computed against. Should match top-level metric.

chosen_value.description: Metric value for the chosen path.

rejected_value_median.description: Median metric value across all rejected paths.

pct_savings.description: Percent improvement: (rejected_median - chosen) / rejected_median * 100. Positive = chosen is better. Example: 98.0 means chosen used 2% of the tokens the rejected path would have used.

example_failure_mode_avoided.description: Short description of the anti-pattern the rejected path represents. This is the teaching signal for training. Examples: 'read-then-rewrite over native cp', 'Glob+Read cascade over gad ask', 'main-thread serial tool calls over subagent parallel dispatch', 'hand-editing JSONL over gad CLI', 'killing PIDs by hand over gad team stop --all'.

agent_id.description: Agent that executed or would have executed this sequence.

license_class.description: Data provenance for redistribution gating. owned = monorepo trace data. open = reproducible from public artifacts. restricted = contains private keys/secrets/PII (exclude from open datasets). customer_private = operator-specific proprietary context.

examples.goal: Copy all compiled artifacts from dist/ to the deploy staging directory deploy/

actions.rationale: Native shell copy — single syscall, zero token emission for file contents.

examples.example_failure_mode_avoided: read-then-rewrite over native cp: agent emitted full file contents as output tokens for every file in the directory, spending 340x the tokens of a single shell cp command

examples.goal: Find where the worker-loop calls rotation in the GAD codebase

inputs.command: gad ask "where does worker-loop call rotation in vendor/get-anything-done"

actions.rationale: gad ask hits the trained semantic index of the GAD ecosystem — single call, returns citations.

examples.example_failure_mode_avoided: Glob+Read cascade over gad ask: agent forages the filesystem with 6 tool calls reading raw source, when the GAD semantic index already has this answer in a single lookup

examples.goal: Run 5 independent code-analysis tasks across different packages in the monorepo

actions.rationale: Parallel dispatch — all 5 subagents run concurrently.

examples.example_failure_mode_avoided: main-thread serial tool calls over subagent parallel dispatch: agent read files sequentially in the main thread spending 4.3x wall time and 7x cost vs dispatching 5 independent subagents that run concurrently
